sessionPresetRouting.description: Enable per-session preset binding and inference routing independently of Slim task controls. When absent, follows backgroundJobs.mode (native enables routing, off disables it). The static preset still applies at startup.

replaceBuiltinSubagents.description: Hide undeclared OpenCode general and explore subagents in favor of Slim specialists. Set false to leave the host roster untouched. Default true.

questionTimeoutMs.description: Opt-in question auto-answer timeout in milliseconds. Unset or 0 disables it; otherwise 60,000–2,147,483,647. Permission and closed-choice requests are never answered. On v2, requires an attached OMOS TUI with tui enabled.

tui.description: Master switch for all OMOS TUI surfaces (sidebar, /preset, /killall, /subagent, update notice). When false, the TUI entry registers nothing and the server records no sidebar state; other server-side features are untouched. Defaults to true.

compactSidebar.description: Use the compact TUI sidebar layout. Defaults to true; set false to use the expanded layout.

sidebarShowHiddenAgents.description: Render internal Council agents (council, councillor, and the dynamic councillor-<seat> agents) as rows in the OMOS TUI sidebar. Defaults to false: those agents stay hidden from the sidebar because their seats are internal orchestration surfaces. When true, each row shows its model and status dot like any other agent; agent registration, availability, and the host agent picker are unchanged.

sidebar.description: Master switch for the OMOS TUI sidebar surface (the agent list it renders and its state file). When false, the plugin never registers or renders the sidebar and writes no sidebar state; the other OMOS TUI surfaces (/preset, /killall, /subagent, update notice) are unaffected, and the native host sidebar is untouched. Defaults to true.

liveConfigRefresh.description: Master switch for the config-file watcher that reloads model/preset profiles. With no session-preset, sidebar, or retry consumer, no watcher or profile seed is constructed. Set false to apply file edits only after restart; explicit preset applications remain available.

stripOrchestratorModel.description: When true, omit orchestrator.model and orchestrator.variant from the SDK config so OpenCode uses the session model selected with /model after subagent dispatch. An explicitly selected preset that sets orchestrator.model is preserved. Defaults to false.

routingBlock.description: When false, removes the <Agents> routing block from the built-in orchestrator prompt. The host's native subagent roster (appended to the subagent tool description) still lists every enabled agent, but it carries no Delegate/Don't routing criteria — set false only to drop stock routing claims that drift against custom agent prompts, or to trim tokens. No effect when an orchestrator.md override already replaces the whole prompt. Defaults to true.

autoUpdate.description: Master switch for OMOS plugin updates: when false, all update checks, update notices, and automatic installation stay off. Defaults to true.

skills_add.description: Skill names to add to this agent's effective skills list. Applied after the resolved `skills` list during config resolution; removal via `skills_remove` wins. Folded into `skills` at resolution time.

skills_remove.description: Skill names to remove from this agent's effective skills list. Applied after `skills_add` during config resolution, so removal wins over addition. Folded into `skills` at resolution time.

skills_include_local.description: When true, adds valid skills from the current/ancestor project `.opencode/skills/**/SKILL.md` and `.agents/skills/**/SKILL.md` trees to this agent's effective skills before `skills_remove`. Global and external skill sources are excluded.

color.description: Agent display color as #RRGGBB or an OpenCode theme color

subagents.description: Built-in orchestrator only: allowed specialist names for its delegation scope (allowlist). Compiled into the `task` permission stance; an explicit `permission.task` entry wins. Rendered as the agent's scoped <Agents> catalog. Entries accept internal names, display names, or @-mentions. `'*'` is reserved.

agents_add.description: Package IDs to add to the inherited marketplace agents list after optional agents replacement.

agents_remove.description: Package IDs to remove after additions; removal wins over addition.

disabled_agents.description: Agent names to disable completely. Disabled agents are not instantiated and cannot be delegated to. Orchestrator and council internal agents (councillor) cannot be disabled. By default, 'observer' is disabled. Remove it from this list and configure a vision-capable model to enable.

image_routing.description: How image attachments are handled. When omitted, preserves legacy conditional behavior: intercept attachments only when observer is enabled. "auto": requires observer to be enabled and saves attachments to disk before nudging delegation to @observer. "direct": always passes attachments to the orchestrator untouched.

disabled_mcps.description: MCP server names to disable completely. Disabled servers are not started and cannot be used by agents.

disabled_tools.description: Tool names to disable completely. Disabled tools are not registered with OpenCode and cannot be used by agents.

disabled_skills.description: Skill names to disable completely. Disabled skills are not granted to agents, even when referenced by presets or agent overrides.

disabled_hooks.description: Hook names to disable completely. Valid values: phase-reminder, foreground-fallback, deepwork-goal, chat-headers, cache-monitor, tool-loop-guard, search-path-guard, absolute-path-rescue, apply-patch, council-inject. "phase-reminder" is not registered, so orchestrator phase reminders are never injected; "foreground-fallback" prevents the fallback manager and its retry hook from being constructed at all, so no automatic intervention runs on any host (fallback.enabled = false still leaves the retry bookkeeping registered on v2 hosts, where a live per-session enable can switch it back on); "chat-headers" is not registered, so the Copilot x-initiator header is never stamped (v1 chat.headers and the v2 model.request bridge); "cache-monitor" stops the prompt-cache bust watchdog, so cache warnings are never logged; the on-demand tool guards ("tool-loop-guard", "search-path-guard", "absolute-path-rescue", "apply-patch" — v1 apply_patch / v2 patch) stop intercepting tool calls entirely, so repeated identical calls and invalid or guessed paths surface raw to the model; "council-inject" is not registered, so the keyword-triggered Council Mode injection is never appended to orchestrator messages. Unknown values are stripped with a warning when the config loads. A value consisting only of unknown names is treated as unset, so a lower config layer's list still applies.

disabled_commands.description: Slash-command names to disable completely. Valid values: implement, interview, deepwork, reflect, preset, killall, subagent. Disabled commands are neither registered nor intercepted at execution time, so a user-defined command with the same name is left untouched. The /reflect command is also disabled when "reflect" is listed in disabled_skills. Unknown values are stripped with a warning when the config loads. A value consisting only of unknown names is treated as unset, so a lower config layer's list still applies.

cmux_tui_binary.description: Explicit path to the cmux-tui binary. When unset, the adapter probes PATH for `cmux-tui` first and falls back to `cmux`.

viewer.description: Which opencode TUI surface subagent panes open. Defaults to "tui" on OpenCode v1 and "mini" on v2. "mini" uses `attach ... --mini` on v1 (requires OpenCode >= 1.17.10) and `opencode mini` on v2; "tui" runs the full interface.

equalize_panes.description: Herdr only: re-equalize the agent panes after each spawn and agent-pane close. Set false to keep manual pane sizes.

agents.description: Which subagents get a pane: ["*"] (default) opens one for every child, ["*", "!explorer"] opens one for every child except the excluded names, and ["oracle", "fixer"] opens one only for the listed names. A filtered-out subagent still runs; only its pane is skipped.

enabled.description: When false, the interview subsystem is not wired up at all: the /interview command is not intercepted, the interview server and dashboard never start, and no interview state or output machinery runs. The native host is untouched. Default true.

autoOpenBrowser.description: Automatically open the interview UI in your default browser during interactive runs. Disabled automatically in tests and CI.

printState.description: When true, the interview model prints the full <interview_state> block in the TUI instead of submitting state through the interview_submit_state tool.

mode.description: Slim task controls: "native" (default) exposes task_status, task_cancel, task_reply and task_report; "off" registers none. Both use the native OpenCode lifecycle. Session preset routing defaults to on in native and off in off; sessionPresetRouting overrides that default.

maxRetries.description: Number of current-model retries allowed before Slim switches to the next fallback model (or aborts when no chain is configured). The budget is shared across the whole fallback chain and is not reset by a model switch; it resets only on a successful assistant response, session deletion, or a new user turn. 0 switches immediately.

initialRetryDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before triggering the first fallback on a failover-worthy error. Gives intercepting plugins time to recover the current model before the fallback chain advances. 0 disables.

retryDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds between consecutive fallback attempts after the initial trigger. 0 disables.

continuationPolicy.description: Model policy for unpinned OpenCode v1 internal continuations (for example, background completion and lifecycle wakes) after a confirmed fallback. "retry-primary" lets the host try the configured primary again; "stick-to-fallback" keeps the confirmed fallback until a new external user turn.

propertyNames.description: Councillor name; the legacy "master" key was removed

binaryPath.description: Path to a custom companion binary to launch.

gifPack.description: Bundled companion animation pack to use.

loopStyle.description: Companion animation playback style: classic loops or smooth ping-pong playback.

speed.description: Companion animation playback speed multiplier. Defaults to 1.

debug.description: Enable verbose native companion debug logs.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for a single ACP run in milliseconds. Set to 0 to disable the timeout.

enabled.description: Master switch for the marketplace subsystem (manager, store, and the marketplace_inspect/marketplace_manage tools). When false, any selected package IDs (per-preset marketplace activation) are ignored and the subsystem is not initialized; the native host is untouched. Default true.
